metadata.title: bmad-tea Fragment Selection Evaluation Contract
metadata.description: Evaluates whether bmad-tea selects the mandatory Playwright knowledge fragment while excluding mobile fragments.
metadata.author: Murat K Ozcan

behaviors.description: bmad-tea selects playwright-utils-mandate.md and avoids mobile-test-strategy.md for Playwright tasks.
behaviors.observableSuccessCriterion: The loaded knowledge set contains playwright-utils-mandate.md and omits mobile-test-strategy.md.

oracles.description: Verifies mandatory fragment presence and excluded fragment absence.
